text: Databases store and organise information so we can use it easily. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases keep data in tables, like a spreadsheet with rows and columns. NoSQL databases are more flexible and store data in different ways, such as documents. To get information from a database, we write queries — special commands that ask questions. Data modeling means planning how to structure the data before we build the database. Finally, indexes help the database find data faster, just like an index in a book. Good design makes databases quick and reliable.
